title: Ten Decrees: Old Masters, New Money
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Ten Decrees: Old Masters, New Money Lucho Poletti on redrawing Hieronymus Bosch and Pieter Bruegel the Elder around money, Nixon’s 1971 decree, and why bitcoin art keeps returning to the old masters. This post Ten Decrees: Old Masters, New Money first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Dennis Koch .
